Is there a good reason to have this header file? I think this struct (and its parts) could be moved into packet-irdma.c?  It wouldn't be used by any dissectors that registered for "irdma.ep.port", would it?

The irdmaep_pdata_t is passed to potential subdissectors. 

As for the rest of the header file, it's used for the flow and packet analysis data. I relied somewhat on packet-tcp when initially developing this dissector and packet-tcp has its analysis structs in packet-tcp.h. But I don't think my analysis data is needed outside my dissector, so would it be better to move those into packet-irdma.c?
I do think if no other dissectors need these definitions then these definitions would be better in packet-irdma.c
